verdict.rationale: Okta's official open-source MCP server explicitly lets LLMs and AI agents perform Okta management operations using natural language. The docs show example prompts such as creating a user and adding them to a group, listing failed logins, and finding unused apps (okta-gh-1, okta-gh-2, okta-gh-3). However, this works only through an external LLM or agent client, and its scope is limited to the Admin Management APIs. Missing for 10: a native natural-language interface built into the Okta product itself, independent or hands-on corroboration that the NL operations work reliably, and coverage beyond admin management operations.
